tenant.q1: Is OpenKey really free for tenants?
tenant.a1: Yes, OpenKey is completely free for tenants with no hidden fees, subscription costs, or application charges. You get access to our AI-powered matching, application assistance, and ongoing support at no cost. We're paid by landlords, so your success is our business model.
tenant.q2: How quickly can I find housing?
tenant.a2: Most tenants using OpenKey find suitable housing 60% faster than traditional methods, typically within 2-4 weeks. Our AI matches you with pre-screened, voucher-friendly properties and landlords who are actively seeking tenants like you. Start browsing verified listings today.
tenant.q3: What if I've been denied housing before?
tenant.a3: OpenKey specializes in connecting tenants who've faced housing discrimination with landlords committed to fair housing practices. Our platform pre-screens both parties for compatibility, significantly reducing rejections. Over 85% of our matched applicants receive approval on their first or second application.
tenant.q4: Do I need perfect credit or employment history?
tenant.a4: No, OpenKey works with tenants across all credit ranges and employment situations. We help landlords see the full picture of your application, including voucher stability and our tenant success support. Many of our partner landlords prioritize voucher reliability over traditional credit requirements.
tenant.q5: What support do I get during the application process?
tenant.a5: You receive dedicated application assistance, document preparation help, and communication support throughout your housing search. Our team helps present your application professionally and advocates for you with landlords. We're with you from initial search to move-in day.
tenant.q6: Are all properties really Section 8 friendly?
tenant.a6: Yes, every property on OpenKey is verified to accept housing vouchers and meet local housing authority requirements. We personally vet each landlord's commitment to voucher acceptance and fair housing practices. No more wasted time on properties that won't accept your voucher.
tenant.a7: Yes, we use bank-level encryption and maintain SOC 2 compliance for data protection. Personal information is only shared with verified, consenting parties during the application process. Your data is never sold or used for marketing, and you control all privacy settings through your secure dashboard.

landlord.a1: We use a comprehensive screening process including background checks, rental history verification, and financial stability assessment through voucher programs. Our AI system evaluates tenant-property compatibility for long-term success. You receive detailed tenant profiles with verified voucher status and housing authority relationships.
landlord.q2: What's the typical time to fill a vacancy?
landlord.a2: OpenKey landlords fill vacancies 45% faster than traditional marketing, averaging 12-18 days versus 30+ days industry standard. Our pre-qualified tenant pool and AI matching means you see serious, voucher-verified applicants immediately. Start receiving qualified applications within 24-48 hours of listing.
landlord.q3: How do you handle problem tenants?
landlord.a3: We provide ongoing tenant support and mediation services to prevent issues before they escalate into costly problems. Our tenant success team works with residents on lease compliance and property care. Should issues arise, we offer conflict resolution and housing authority coordination to protect your investment.
landlord.q4: What are the costs for landlords?
landlord.a4: OpenKey operates on a success-based model with competitive placement fees only when you successfully lease to our tenants. No upfront costs, monthly fees, or marketing expenses. Most landlords save 60-80% compared to traditional property management while achieving faster, more reliable tenant placement.
landlord.q5: How do you ensure rent payments?
landlord.a5: Housing vouchers provide exceptional payment reliability, with housing authorities handling 70-100% of rent directly. Our platform includes payment tracking, automated reminders, and housing authority coordination for seamless rent collection. Voucher tenants have historically lower default rates than market-rate renters.
landlord.q6: What ongoing support do landlords receive?
landlord.a6: You get access to our landlord dashboard for tenant communications, maintenance requests, and performance analytics. Our team provides ongoing consultation on voucher regulations, market trends, and property optimization. Plus 24/7 support for any tenant or housing authority related questions.
landlord.a7: OpenKey has zero tolerance for housing discrimination and actively monitors all interactions for fair housing compliance. Our platform includes automated bias detection, fair housing training for landlords, and direct reporting mechanisms. We work closely with housing advocacy groups and maintain HUD partnership standards.

manager.q1: Can I manage multiple properties on one account?
manager.a1: Yes, our property management dashboard allows you to oversee unlimited properties from a single account. You can track occupancy rates, manage applications across your portfolio, and coordinate with multiple housing authorities simultaneously. Each property maintains its own detailed analytics and tenant history.
manager.q2: How do you handle bulk operations for large portfolios?
manager.a2: OpenKey provides bulk listing tools, mass communication features, and portfolio-wide reporting for property managers with 10+ units. You can upload multiple properties via CSV, send broadcasts to all tenants, and generate comprehensive reports across your entire portfolio. Save hours of administrative work weekly.
manager.q3: What are the fees for property management companies?
manager.a3: Property managers receive volume discounts starting at 25+ units, with tiered pricing that decreases as your portfolio grows. We offer white-label solutions for larger management companies and enterprise-level API integrations. Contact us for custom pricing based on your portfolio size and specific needs.
manager.q4: Can I integrate OpenKey with my existing property management software?
manager.a4: Yes, we offer API integrations with major property management platforms including Yardi, RentManager, and AppFolio. Our integration team will work with you to sync tenant data, automate lease renewals, and streamline your existing workflows. Most integrations are completed within 2-3 weeks.
manager.q5: How do you coordinate with multiple housing authorities?
manager.a5: Our platform automatically handles different housing authority requirements, inspection schedules, and payment processes across all your markets. We maintain direct relationships with housing authorities in 48 states, ensuring compliant operations regardless of location. Reduce administrative complexity while expanding your geographic reach.
manager.q6: What reporting and analytics do you provide for portfolios?
manager.a6: Property managers get comprehensive dashboards showing occupancy trends, application conversion rates, average time-to-lease, and revenue analytics across all properties. Generate custom reports for ownership groups, track performance by market, and identify optimization opportunities. Export data in multiple formats for accounting integration.
manager.a7: OpenKey operates across 48 US states (all except Hawaii and Alaska) and is expanding internationally with operations in 5 countries, with more launching soon. We work with local housing authorities in each market to ensure compliance and streamlined voucher processing. Check if your area is active or join our expansion waitlist.
manager.a8: Our dedicated support team provides 24/7 assistance for any issues that arise during your housing search or tenancy. We offer dispute resolution, housing authority advocacy, and emergency support services. Most issues are resolved within 24 hours, with escalation procedures for complex situations.
